title: Local classicality gives affine section continuity
statement: Let X be a scheme and F a pro-etale sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Suppose a pro-etale covering family U_i has F restricted to each U_i isomorphic to ν_(U_i)^*G_i for an etale sheaf G_i [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Then every small cofiltered presentation of an affine ind-etale X-object by affine etale X-objects [lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis] is carried by F to the colimit of its section sets, with the canonical restriction maps.

proof.text: Raw restriction along a weakly etale structure map is the scheme inverse image: map and pullback are adjoint on the sites, and uniqueness of sheaf left adjoints identifies restriction with the constructed inverse image. Commutation of the two base-change restriction functors, and conjugation of these adjunctions, identifies restriction of a classical sheaf with the comparison inverse image of its etale inverse image. This uses only the canonical constructions, not the identity/composition/square coherence theorem.

For each affine basis object V over X, index the refinement by all triples (Z,i,g), where Z is an affine ind-etale object over V and g:Z→U_i is a morphism over X. The composite affine-inclusion/localization functor is cocontinuous, so pulling back the original covering sieves proves that this family covers. The previous comparison transports each classical presentation to Z.

Over an affine base the affine ind-etale category has a terminal object and pullbacks, hence binary products. For a cofiltered limit C=lim C_j form the diagram of presheaves P_j(V)=F(C_j times V) and the cocone Q(V)=F(C times V). They are sheaves because product with a fixed object is continuous: factor the product functor as Over.star followed by Over.forget.

The topology is generated by finite presieves with pairwise pullbacks. The pointwise filtered colimit of the P_j is a sheaf. Explicitly, lift finitely many local sections to one stage; compatibility is finitely many equations on pairwise pullbacks and therefore holds at a common later stage. Stagewise gluing gives an amalgamation. The same common-stage equality argument proves uniqueness, including an empty finite presieve.

For an object V mapping to a refined cover member, regard the product diagram C_j times V as a diagram over that member. Its transition and projection morphisms are pro-affine-etale. Forgetting to schemes preserves its cofiltered limit and reflects it over the new base. Apply classical continuity there. The induced comparison from the pointwise colimit of P_j to Q is therefore an isomorphism on the slice of each cover member. Local detection of isomorphisms makes it globally invertible. Evaluate at the terminal affine object, using the product unitor, to obtain section continuity.

For a general X and a relative affine etale presentation, choose a stage j0 and restrict to the cofinal category Over j0. The diagram and limit lift to affine ind-etale schemes over that affine stage, where the preceding argument applies to the restriction of F and the refined classical cover. The opposite forgetful functor is final, so its section colimit is also the original section colimit.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof by E4. Finite sheaf-colimit proof adapted from Bin Wu's proved finite-presieve argument with the required larger object and section universes. All geometry and cocone identifications are proved here.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_locallyClassical_continuity (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1)))
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → X.ProEt) (hU : (ProEt.topology X).CoversTop U)
    (hF : ∀ i, ∃ G : Sheaf (U i).left.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)), Nonempty
      (((@Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (U i).left.ProEt _ X.ProEt _
          (MorphismProperty.Over.map (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤ (U i).prop)
          (Type (u + 1)) _ (ProEt.topology (U i).left) (ProEt.topology X)
          (ProEt.isContinuous_overMap (U i).prop)).obj F) ≅
        (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (toProEt (U i).left)
          (Type (u + 1)) (U i).left.smallEtaleTopology
          (ProEt.topology (U i).left)).obj G)) :
    Functor.PreservesRelativeFilteredColimits.{u} (AffineEtale.toAffineProEt X)
      ((AffineProEt.toProEt X).op ⋙ F.obj)
